newsitem.title: USA: LCI International sees Q4 eps, sales growth.
newsitem.headline: LCI International sees Q4 eps, sales growth.

text.p: LCI International said it expects to report growth in revenues and earnings per share for its fiscal fourth quarter of 1996.
The company also said it expects to report minutes growth for the quarter, it said, although gave no more details.

The revenue for the quarter will reflect a five to six percent growth in minutes from the same period last year, the company said. The company gave no figures for earnings growth, and could not be immediately reached.
LCI said it plans to issue its fourth-quarter and year-end results on February 6.
